invariants: Normalization and resolution perform no DNS or scheme-specific effects
Every produced byte is checked against the caller-selected output bound
Results are caller-owned UTF-8 byte arrays with no escaping temporary Text view
Scheme and registered-name case normalization are separate explicit policy fields
Percent-encoded unreserved decoding and percent-hex case are explicit policy fields
Dot-segment removal preserves whether the input path is relative or absolute
Relative resolution follows RFC 3986 component inheritance without a hidden base
All 42 RFC 3986 section 5.4 resolution examples plus empty query and fragment boundaries are covered
All URI fixtures compile under the managed compiler and execute with exact output on Windows, Linux under WSL, and a Node-hosted wasm32-browser ABI harness
Browser URI programs import only the allowlisted bounded allocator, reallocator, memset, memcpy, output, and panic host functions and no file, clock, random, DNS, or network effect
